description: A UI change is reviewable only when it can be seen: screenshots come from a command, a branch that changes UI files updates them, and accessibility and design tokens are checked.

opinions.summary: A branch that changes files matching ui.paths also updates files under docs/screenshots/.
Files under ui.paths use design tokens; raw colour literals (hex, rgb, hsl) appear only in the files named by ui.tokens.
check a11y runs axe-core on every route at every viewport and theme; serious and critical violations fail.
Every interactive element is reachable and operable by keyboard.
The PR body links the updated screenshots at the head commit.
Interactive or animated work is recorded with screenshot --capture, and the PR body links the updated videos at the head commit.
A screen state that is not its own route is declared under states in ui.json, and screenshot captures it after its steps.
A UI ticket says what the screen shows when empty, loading, failed and full.
A ticket that changes a screen gets a wireframe under docs/design/<ticket>/ first, captured with screenshot --wireframe and approved by the owner before the build ticket starts.
